summary.zh: 落地整洁架构、六边形与领域驱动设计
summary.en: Apply Clean, Hexagonal, and Domain-Driven Design

description.zh: 指导新微服务的整洁架构分层、单体到限界上下文的拆分，以及六边形与洋葱架构的落地。也用于排查应用层之间的依赖环。适合架构评审或大规模重构前参考。
description.en: Guidance for Clean, Hexagonal, and onion architecture in new services and monolith refactors, covering bounded contexts and dependency-cycle fixes. Fits architecture reviews and pre-refactor planning.
